headline: Midnight finds the desk still lit.
body: A bus brakes once at the corner and does not come back. The kettle has gone quiet; the radiator has not. We leave the page open and the lamp on its lowest setting.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: clear, moon high, no cloud bank

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: desk lamp, one window opposite still yellow

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet curb, last bin lid settling
